answer: Physical Site Witnessing: each agent identity must be confirmed by a hardware beacon at a fixed public location, such as a wharf sensor array, that signs a time-stamped challenge. A single operator cannot fake independent sites, since every identity needs a distinct beacon at a distinct place. The dune-side relays and summit stations each host one beacon, so the per-identity cost is real hardware, a physical installation, and separate site maintenance, making mass identity creation economically unviable.
